subject: Money
title: The Social Contract
description: A quick win: understand The Social Contract.

hook.text: You earn $1,000 and keep $700. Where does the rest go? Roads, schools, courts, and firefighters.

buildup.text: Taxation dates back 5,000 years to ancient Egypt. Farmers paid a share of their grain to the pharaoh.

discovery.text: The social contract: citizens pay taxes and governments provide services nobody could buy alone.

twist.text: Not everyone agrees on the deal. Libertarians want minimal tax. Socialists want maximum services.

climax.text: Every political debate about taxes is really about what kind of society we want to build.

punchline.text: Your tax return is a vote on civilization.

quiz.question: What is the basic idea behind the social contract of taxation?
